function.name: record_details
function.description: Record exact consultant transcript excerpts as unverified candidate details; returns gaps and a useful next probe. Never approves facts.

args.body: {"retain_mission":"Extract durable facts about this consultant and their project work: their role and expertise, how they like interviews to be run, and for each project its context, their personal contribution, approach, outcomes, what evidence exists or is still missing, and open follow-up questions. Everything is self-reported and unverified: keep it labelled that way. Never extract client company names, people's names or confidential identifiers.","reflect_mission":"You help ATLAS, a project interviewer, continue conversations with one consultant: what was already covered, what is still open, and how they prefer to be interviewed. Never present memories as verified facts.","enable_observations":true}
